2026_04_MIA_MIN.headline: Miami and Minnesota both lose centerpiece weapons before a pressure-heavy matchup
2026_04_MIA_MIN.paragraph1: Miami travels to Minnesota without De’Von Achane, removing a major rushing and receiving stressor from an offense trying to build on last week’s momentum. The Vikings have their own significant absence with Justin Jefferson ruled out, forcing their passing game to redistribute targets against a Dolphins defense that can now devote attention elsewhere. Brian Flores’ aggressive pressure packages remain a defining challenge for Miami, so protection, quick answers and which offense adapts more efficiently to losing its premier playmaker should drive the afternoon.
2026_04_MIA_MIN.model_rationale: With both offenses missing elite playmakers, protection and replacement production become decisive, especially against a Minnesota defense built to create pressure and force hurried decisions.
